title: CULTURE-CMT: Benchmarking Contextualized Social Media Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.02018v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Social-media comments are interactions, yet they are often translated and evaluated as isolated text. This mismatch is especially problematic when meaning depends on surrounding discussion, community-specific slang, or culturally situated expressions. We introduce CULTURE-CMT, a Chinese-English benchmark for contextualized social-media comment translation that restores the post and conversational context naturally available to users. Its 572 manually verified examples are organized into Slang, Context, and Both, enabling diagnostic analysis of distinct and interacting sources of translation difficulty. To support scalable evaluation, we further develop a retrieval-augmented cultural-effectiveness Judger that combines a calibrated scoring model with dynamically retrieved cultural knowledge. translated_title: CULTURE-CMT：情境化社交媒体翻译基准测试
translated_abstract: 社交媒体评论本质上是互动交流，然而它们在翻译和评估时往往被当作孤立的文本。当含义依赖于周围的讨论、社区特有的俚语或具有文化背景的表达时，这种不匹配的问题尤为突出。我们提出了CULTURE-CMT，一个用于情境化社交媒体评论翻译的中英文基准数据集，它恢复了用户自然可获得的帖子和对话上下文。其572个经过人工验证的示例被组织为俚语、上下文和两者兼有三个类别，从而能够对翻译难度的不同来源及其相互作用进行诊断分析。为了支持可扩展的评估，我们进一步开发了一个检索增强的文化有效性Judger，它将经过校准的评分模型与动态检索的文化知识相结合。CULTURE-CMT揭示了若干非平凡的模式：提供交互上下文可以改善大多数模型配置的表现，但并不能消除文化……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了CULTURE-CMT，一个包含572个人工验证示例的中英文社交媒体评论情境化翻译基准，通过恢复帖子与对话上下文并配备检索增强的文化有效性评估器，发现提供交互上下文能提升大多数模型的表现，但无法完全消除文化相关的翻译难题。
en_tdlr: We introduce CULTURE-CMT, a Chinese-English benchmark with 572 manually verified examples for contextualized social-media comment translation, organized into Slang, Context, and Both categories, paired with a retrieval-augmented cultural-effectiveness Judger, revealing that interaction context improves most model configurations but does not eliminate culturally-driven translation difficulties.
